deprecation.reason: Property 'spring.prism.mcp.security-strict-mode' is deprecated; use the top-level 'spring.prism.failure-mode' instead.

properties.name: spring.prism.active-defense.max-restored-tokens-per-response
properties.description: Maximum number of <PRISM_...> tokens that may be restored within a single LLM response or streaming session before Spring Prism aborts processing with a PrismProtectionException (reason=EXFILTRATION_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED). Use -1 to disable the limit. Available since 1.2.0.

values.description: Disable the Active Defense exfiltration limit (not recommended in production).
Default ceiling; balances LLM expressiveness with anti-exfiltration protection.
